Gemini CLI extension hooks. Gemini reads hooks/hooks.json at the extension root and the path is NOT configurable — its docs are explicit that hooks are not declared in gemini-extension.json. Claude Code scans that same path at the plugin root REGARDLESS of what .claude-plugin/plugin.json declares, so shipping this file there broke the one plugin install that works: Claude reported `Failed to load hooks` on every session over BeforeTool, AfterTool and PreCompress, which are Gemini's event names and not spelling mistakes.

Found by installing the plugin and reading the error, which is what scripts/acceptance.md exists for — the suite drives each adapter's hook and cannot know which files a tool decides to open on its own.

So it lives here, off the contested path. Gemini's DROP-IN install is unaffected: adapters/gemini/adapter.json wires .gemini/settings.json and carries no dependency on this file. What is not available until the collision has a real answer is Gemini-as-an-extension, which the README already lists as next rather than supported.

hooks.name: ddw-session-start
hooks.description: DDW: boot the pipeline for this session

hooks.name: ddw-pre-tool-use
hooks.description: DDW: refuse a write the FSM does not allow

hooks.name: ddw-post-write
hooks.description: DDW: revalidate the state on disk

hooks.name: ddw-pre-compress
hooks.description: DDW: re-read the pipeline after compression, never infer it
